settings.label: Logo
settings.info: Leave empty to use the vector Rizo mark (sharper, and it follows the colours below).

settings.label: Night
settings.info: The darkest colour. The sky and every page start here.

settings.label: Bone
settings.info: Text and light surfaces.

settings.label: Rizo blue
settings.info: The flame, the X that marks where you are, focus rings. Used sparingly.

settings.label: Motion
settings.info: Calm halves seasonal motion and removes image zoom on hover. Visitors who ask their device for reduced motion always get a still site.

settings.content: Badges: SOLD OUT always wins. A custom.badge product metafield overrides the automatic ones. Automatic tags (lowercase): new-drop, low-stock, restocked, event-exclusive, core-piece.

settings.label: Low-stock badge below
settings.info: Only for tracked inventory that stops selling at zero.

settings.label: Bottom bar on phones
settings.info: Home, Shop, Search and Cart within thumb reach.

settings.label: Free shipping from
settings.info: 0 hides the progress bar. Only set this when the offer is real.

settings.content: A seasonal change to the world around the store: sky, moon, fog, bats, countdown. Off returns to normal Rizo instantly; nothing is deleted. See docs/EVENT-LAYER.md.

settings.label: Start
settings.info: ISO date/time. Without an offset it is read in the event's timezone (New York for Halloween). Blank uses the event's own window.

settings.label: End
settings.info: Halloween's own window: Sep 23 12:00 AM to Nov 1 6:00 AM, New York time.

settings.label: Always preview in the theme editor
settings.info: Customers still follow the schedule. Add ?rizo_event=on to any storefront link to preview in a normal tab.

settings.label: Announcement during the event
settings.info: Shown above the header only while the event is live.

settings.label: Night sky
settings.info: Deepens the sky and lets the moon light a little of it. Product photos are never tinted.

settings.label: Motion
settings.info: Scales fog drift and bat flight. 0% keeps everything still.

options.label: Still moon and fog, no bats

settings.label: Moon artwork
settings.info: Square, transparent, the disc filling the frame. Blank uses the event's moon.

settings.label: Phase
settings.info: The real phase follows the actual moon over Pittsburgh, including the dark nights around the new moon.

settings.label: Moon moves
settings.info: It sets toward the footer as people scroll, crosses the sky slowly during a visit and travels between pages. Off keeps it still.

settings.content: Where the moon hangs on each kind of page is art direction in assets/rizo.css (Sky positions).

settings.label: Density
settings.info: Fog always clears over products, the product page and the cart. Each section has its own fog setting.

settings.label: Follow Pittsburgh's clock
settings.info: Thicker at dawn, when the rivers fog over; thinnest in the afternoon.

settings.label: How many at once
settings.info: Share of the limit: 10 on desktop, 6 on phones, 4 on low-power devices.

settings.label: How often
settings.info: Lower leaves longer quiet stretches. 0% means only scrolling, taps and the moon wake them.

settings.label: A bat roosts on the page
settings.info: One bat hangs under an edge, notices the pointer, leaves when disturbed and comes back somewhere else.

settings.label: Taps scatter them
settings.info: Bats never block a tap: buttons, links and cart controls always get the click.

settings.label: Counts down to
settings.info: Blank uses the event's moment. Halloween: Oct 31 2026, 12:00 AM New York time, whatever the visitor's timezone.
